answer: A grove of twelve identities is called to the lagoon once per epoch: at a random minute, announced five minutes ahead, all twelve must be present in the lagoon and each sign the fresh vine — a hash chain whose tip is published at the call — inside the same ninety-second window, so nothing can be prepared in advance. A missed roll suspends the identity until the next epoch's call. Keeping 1,000 puppets ready means staffing 1,000 live sessions for the whole six-hour epoch, 6,000 operator-hours per call, while one honest member answers one roll and goes back to work.
